in_sanskrit.name: Chaitrikaa
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has power, growth, ability and action. It is the name of a lunar mansions (Nakshatras) and a goddess associated with the lunar day of the same name. The goddess Chaitra is also known as the goddess of youth, beauty and creativity.

in_hindi.name: चैत्रिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has power, growth, and ability to do things.

in_tamil.name: சைத்ரிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is prosperous, beautiful and charming.

in_telugu.name: చైత్రికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is powerful, grown and beautiful.

in_marathi.name: Chaitrikaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitrikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaitra is the name of the lunar month in which the Hindu festival of Holi is celebrated. The prefix 'kaa' in Chaitrikaa denotes the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. This name is believed to bring abundance and prosperity.
